page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.large is a general-purpose instance type configured with a balanced 1:4 compute-to-memory architecture. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, providing 4 vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores with hyper-threading. The CPU cache architecture comprises 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and a 35 MB L3 cache. Supported instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512F, AVX-512 VNNI, and hardware-accelerated AES cryptography. Memory capacity totals 16.0 GB, allocating 4.0 GB per physical execution thread. The instance does not bundle any local storage or hardware accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached cloud storage volumes and central processing units.

Standardized benchmarks position the ecs.n2.large in the entry tier for compute and data processing. Stress-ng tests registered a single-core score of 1089.08 and a multi-core score of 4315.32, ranking within the bottom 25% of tested configurations. Geekbench evaluation reflects similar boundaries, with single-core scoring 873.0 and multi-core scoring 2768.0, accompanied by a software compilation score of 4332.0. Memory throughput metrics show mixed behavior: while uncached large-block write bandwidth reaches an average 28.16 GB/sec, large-block read bandwidth is limited to 32.61 GB/sec. Data manipulation workloads show reduced speed, with single-threaded gzip compression achieving 19.03 GB/sec and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression measuring 14.45 GB/sec.

From an efficiency perspective, the dedicated vCPU allocation provides consistent execution behavior for modest workloads without relying on credit exhaustion models. However, the processor generation and low single-core benchmarks limit utility for CPU-bound computations, high-rate database transactions, or high-throughput serialization tasks, as evidenced by Redis SET throughput of 5.02 million operations per second and static web throughput of 3.54 GB/sec. The ecs.n2.large is best suited for general-purpose utility tasks, low-traffic web serving, internal staging environments, background task workers, and baseline business applications that require a balanced 16 GB memory footprint without intensive compute demands.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.large is a general-purpose cloud instance configured with four vCPUs and 16 GB of memory, delivering a balanced 1:4 compute-to-RAM ratio. Built on the x86_64 architecture and running under the KVM hypervisor, it utilizes a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor across two physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. Instruction set support includes AVX-512 and AES acceleration. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage or physical GPUs, requiring external cloud block storage for persistent data. Benchmark assessments indicate modest single-thread and multi-core throughput, with Geekbench single-core scoring 873.0 and multi-core reaching 2768.0, placing overall compute capacity in the lower quartile across evaluated cloud servers. Memory write bandwidth achieves an average 28.16 GB/sec, while read bandwidth and compression performance remain relatively constrained. The ecs.n2.large is appropriate for lightweight enterprise applications, staging environments, basic web serving, and administrative utility services.
